entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I'm calling because I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It works. It's just... I guess I **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** around the holidays, and honestly, I just **don't use it**. I feel really bad about it.
I see, so it's not a defect, you'd just prefer not to keep it. I understand. Let me just pull up your account here. Can I get the order number?

Yes, it's VF-8675309. I've been a loyal customer for a while and I was just so sure I'd use it every day. I really needed this money back for bills this month. I even thought about looking into some kind of **resale** market but it seems like so much work and you never get what you paid.
I appreciate you explaining that, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer. I've got your order pulled up. One moment while I review the return eligibility.
Okay... I'm just hoping you can help.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I see here that your VeloBand was delivered 18 days ago, on December 15th. I've checked our policy, and for this item, you have a 90-day return window.
Wait, really? So I can return it?
Yes, absolutely. You are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and start that return process for you right now for a full refund. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label.
Oh, wow. Thank you so much, Charlie! That's a huge relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it. You've really made my day.

You're very welcome. I'm glad I could help resolve this for you. The email with the label is on its way. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
